name: Translate Side by Side
description: Shows menus, nodes, blocks and taxonomy with source and target language side by side
project_description:
Shows menus, nodes, blocks and taxonomy with source and target language side by side e.g. to provide a translation template for an external translation/review/release workflow. All string and text field types are supported, as well as image (alt, title), file (description) and link (title). Fields are listed in form display order. Works with fields in paragraphs.

 Installation 
 
 Install module as usual. 
 Go to Reports > Translate Side by Side 
 Select target language to view all entities 
 
 Read README.txt for more information.

 For editing all entity-translatable fields of one node inline in a single form in D7 use https://www.drupal.org/project/entity_translation_unified_form
